collection.title: MODIS/Terra Gross Primary Productivity 8-Day L4 Global 500m SIN Grid V061
collection.summary: The MOD17A2H Version 6.1 Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) product is a cumulative 8-day composite of values with 500 meter (m) pixel size based on the radiation use efficiency concept that can be potentially used as inputs to data models to calculate terrestrial energy, carbon, water cycle processes, and biogeochemistry of vegetation. The data product includes information about GPP and Net Photosynthesis (PSN). The PSN band values are the GPP less the Maintenance Respiration (MR). The data product also contains a PSN Quality Control (QC) layer. The quality layer contains quality information for both the GPP and the PSN. Known Issues * For complete information about known issues please refer to the [MODIS/VIIRS Land Quality Assessment website](https://landweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/knownissue?sensor=MODIS&sat=Terra&as=61).

documentation.description: The technical information in the User's Guide enables users to interpret and use the data products.
The ATBD provides physical theory and mathematical procedures for the calculations used to produce the data products.
The File Specification provides a description of the product file including Scientific Data Sets and their attributes.
Validation at stage 3 has been achieved for the MODIS Gross and Net Primary Productivity data products.
Further details regarding MODIS land product validation for the MOD17 data products are available from the MODIS Land Team Validation site.
The LDOPE Land Product Quality Assessment website provides known issues, maneuvers, and product quality of the land products.
